result.title: Unconstrained CTI-REALM with Open-Weights
result.summary: Organisations that want language-model agents for security work face a choice between open-weight models, which they can run and audit themselves, and far more expensive closed frontier models. We study that choice on CTI-REALM (arXiv:2603.13517), a benchmark in which an agent turns a threat-intelligence report into a working detection by querying a live telemetry store. We evaluate twenty-six models, nineteen open-weight and seven closed, under a common harness, scorer and panel of LLM judges. Our main finding is that an open-weight model can match the strongest closed models at less than a tenth of their cost, provided it is given enough turns. The benchmark's published limit on agent messages is a confound: a task that exhausts the limit scores zero on every checkpoint, including those it had already passed, so results at that limit partly measure which models finish in time. At the published limit the leading open-weight and closed models cannot be distinguished. With the limit relaxed, the models it was truncating recover, and the highest rewards belong to open-weight models. Among the leading models, price is a poor guide to capability: models with similar rewards differ in cost by more than an order of magnitude. Because the benchmark's checkpoint scores largely record what an agent did or mentioned, we also introduce stage-level metrics that score what the agent submits, by executing its detection queries in the telemetry store and judging its outputs against the answer key. Rather than combining them into one more overall reward, we show that different models lead different stages, which suggests routing each stage of the workflow to the model that performs it best rather than choosing a single model by its overall score. We also report how many tokens each model generates, and find that the share of output spent on thinking does not track the reward.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在 CTI-REALM 安全检测基准上用统一 harness、评分器与 LLM 评审团评测 26 个开源与闭源模型，发现给予足够轮数后开源模型能以不到十分之一成本匹配最强闭源模型；并指出基准的消息轮数上限构成混淆（超限任务全部记零），提出按阶段执行检测查询、对照答案键打分的阶段级指标。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽非视觉或 latent 推理工作，但其关于轮数上限导致评价「部分衡量谁先完成」、thinking token 占比与奖励脱钩、以及不同模型各擅阶段因而按阶段路由的观察，可能在计算预算、THINK/STOP 成本收益与评价设计上对 LVR 有类比启发，可供核查。
